name: Cost of Living Payments
description: Cost of Living Payments are paid by Inland Revenue to individuals who meet set eligibility criteria, including having net income of $70,000 or less in the 2021/22 tax year.

attributes.summary: A $350 payment administered by Inland Revenue to eligible individuals earning $70,000 or less in 2021/22, paid in instalments or as a lump sum. Exempt from income and cash asset tests for key MSD products for 12 months from receipt.
attributes.eligibility: Net income of $70,000 or less in 2021/22 tax year. Individuals receiving a qualifying benefit for Winter Energy Payment are not eligible. Administered by Inland Revenue to those with a NZ bank account registered with them.
attributes.payment_details: Total payment of $350, generally paid in 3 instalments: $116.67 on the first working day of August 2022, $116.67 on the first working day of September 2022, and $116.66 on the first working day of October 2022. Alternatively, a one-off lump sum payment available up to 31 March 2024.
attributes.income_test: Net income of $70,000 or less in 2021/22 tax year. Payment is exempt from income and cash asset tests for key MSD products for 12 months from date of each payment.
attributes.application_process: No application required. Inland Revenue automatically assesses eligibility and pays individuals with a NZ bank account registered with them.
